title: Lec 44 Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs) as Regularized MLP
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
description: Rigorous derivation and unified architectural formulation of Convolutional Neural Networks as regularized Multi-Layer Perceptrons on grid topologies: discrete sliding inner products, multi-filter feature banks, 3D tensor convolutions across input channels, ERM filter specialization dynamics, subsampling/pooling layers, classic deep backbones, and dense prediction via U-Net transposed convolutions.

topics.title: CNNs as Regularized MLPs: Grid Topology, Sliding Inner Products, and Discrete Convolution Mechanics
Multi-Filter Stacking, Feature Specialization, and 3D Activation Tensors
Multi-Channel Input Tensors: Sensor Physics, Bayer Filter Arrays, and Medical Slices
3D Tensor Convolutions, Channel Marginalization, and Stride-Padding Arithmetic
Optimization Dynamics under ERM: Filter Symmetry Breaking, Overparameterization, and Bias-Variance
Spatial Subsampling: Average Pooling as Fixed Filters vs Max-Pooling Subgradient Routing
End-to-End Classification & Regression Pipelines: Flattening, FC Heads, ResNet Skips, and Inception
Dense Prediction Architectures & U-Net: Semantic Segmentation, Bottlenecks, and Transposed Convolutions
